incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: Inference prod-eu p95 latency > 700ms (5m). Affected routes: /v1/generate. Pager: Mira K. Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/inference-latency. Incident priority: P1. Please acknowledge.
Mira K.: Ack. jumping on it — grabbing recent flamegraphs and logs.
Jamal R.: I see a correlated spike in KV cache miss rate + a couple of tuner pod restarts around 4067889900. Possible rollout + cache pressure. Dumping /metrics now.
Sophie L.: On standby. If we need to, we can flip low-priority traffic to prod-us-hot and scale EU worker pool. Preparing routing patch.
Mira K.: Good. Lia, can you draft a short status page blurb while we triage? Keep it concise and non-alarming.
Lia (Customer Success): Draft for status page: "We are currently investigating elevated latency impacting inference requests in our EU region. Engineers are actively mitigating the issue by rerouting traffic and scaling capacity. You may see degraded latency or reduced throughput for a subset of requests. We expect remediation within 30–45 minutes and will provide updates here." Want this tone?
Dave P.: I'll queue that for publish once Mira confirms mitigations are in place. Also need a quick customer-facing email for impacted accounts.
Sophie L.: Applying routing change now: enable fallback to prod-us-hot for route /v1/generate with weight 0.2 for non-enterprise. Command (will run):
```bash
# enable fallback routing
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/internal/routing/modify -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","fallback":"prod-us-hot","weight":0.2}'
```
Sophie L.: Also scaling eu-infer-worker pool +30%: `kubectl scale deployment/eu-infer-worker --replicas=13`
Mira K.: Routing patch applied and scale kicked. Running cache priming job to warm KV. Initial telemetry: p95 dropped from >700ms to ~420ms over last 2 mins. Continuing to watch.
Jamal R.: Added temporary DEBUG logs and tagged spans: `incident=4067890000`. Observability shows decreased tail latency but some tokens still at 600ms due to cold KV misses.
ops-svcs: :white_check_mark: Status page updated with Lia's draft: https://status.redwood/status/incident-4067890000
Lia (Customer Success): Customer email template (short):
"Subject: Brief service update — elevated latency in EU
Hi —
We experienced elevated inference latency in our EU region earlier today. Our engineers have applied routing fallbacks and increased capacity; services are recovering. Expected full recovery within 30–45 minutes. If you see persistent issues, reply here and we will prioritize.
— Redwood Support"
Mira K.: Good template. Dave — please send to impacted accounts once we confirm stability for 10 minutes.
Dave P.: Will do. Preparing list of impacted customers from billing tags now.
Mira K.: Follow-ups (assigned): Jamal — investigate root cause of KV eviction spike and pod restarts. Sophie — update runbook to automate fallback + scaling on p95 thresholds. Lia — coordinate customer comms and share list with Sales. I'll own the postmortem doc.
Sophie L.: Acknowledged, will add automated playbook and a dry-run test.
Jamal R.: Acknowledged, taking logs and heapdumps for analysis.
Mira K.: Current status: recovering, p95 ~380ms, throughput stabilizing. Will update here in 30m or earlier if regression. If anyone sees a regression ping me directly.
ops-svcs: :loud_sound: Reminder: incident channel owners, please ensure the postmortem template is created under /incidents/4067890000.
Mira K.: Will create PM and assign tickets. Closing coordination notes; monitoring continues.
